description: Configuration for running MethylPredictor on test sample sets.

blind.description: Optional blind cohort: {"groups": [{label, sample_paths}]}. Mutually exclusive with controls/diseases.
blind.title: Blind

classifier_step_snapshot.description: Optional copy of step_config.classifier fields merged into ClassifierConfig during run_prediction (temperature, use_isotonic_calibration, weight_method, etc.).
classifier_step_snapshot.title: Classifier Step Snapshot

cohort_hierarchy.description: Optional tree metadata from project (disease families / stages); used for hierarchy summaries in reports.
cohort_hierarchy.title: Cohort Hierarchy

comparison_label.description: When running per-comparison, the comparison folder label (written to prediction_report.json).
comparison_label.title: Comparison Label

controls.description: Nested control cohort: {label, groups[{label, sample_paths}]}. When test_control_paths is empty and diseases is set, run_prediction expands these.
controls.title: Controls

decision_enabled.description: If true (binary only), derive final_decision in predictions.csv using decision_min_margin and decision_min_confidence thresholds.
decision_enabled.title: Decision Enabled

decision_min_confidence.description: Binary decision policy: minimum max(prob_class0, prob_class1) required to avoid indeterminate.
decision_min_confidence.title: Decision Min Confidence

decision_min_margin.description: Binary decision policy: minimum |prob_class1 - prob_class0| required to avoid indeterminate.
decision_min_margin.title: Decision Min Margin

diseases.description: Nested disease cohort (same shape as project diseases).
diseases.title: Diseases

holdout_control_paths.description: Holdout split: class-0 paths; when any holdout_* paths are set, metrics are split into training vs holdout.
holdout_control_paths.title: Holdout Control Paths

holdout_disease_paths.description: Holdout split: class-1 paths for dual evaluation.
holdout_disease_paths.title: Holdout Disease Paths

holdout_group_paths.description: Multiclass holdout split paths per class.
holdout_group_paths.title: Holdout Group Paths

model_dir.description: Path to directory containing classifier-{chrom}.pkl files (multi-chromosome mode).
model_dir.title: Model Dir

model_path.description: Path to trained classifier .pkl file (single-file mode).
model_path.title: Model Path

output_dir.description: Directory for validation_metrics.json and predictions CSV.
output_dir.title: Output Dir

panel.description: Optional hierarchical panel readout for OvR ECDF bundles (pairwise max-contrast). Set under step_config.predictor.panel in the project JSON. See methyl_classifier.core.panel_fusion.
panel.title: Panel

path_remap.description: Prefix replacement for sample paths: {"old_prefix": "new_prefix"}. Applied when paths come from config.
path_remap.title: Path Remap

report_blind.description: Blind cohort block for prediction_report.json (same shape as predictor.blind).
report_blind.title: Report Blind

report_controls.description: Controls block for prediction_report.json (label + groups with sample_paths), same shape as step_config.predictor.controls.
report_controls.title: Report Controls

sample_lineage.description: Ordered rows parallel to classification input: absolute_path, side, group_label.
sample_lineage.title: Sample Lineage

samples_base_path.description: Base directory to resolve relative sample paths (project-level).
samples_base_path.title: Samples Base Path

test_blind_paths.description: Unlabeled / blind test samples (no expected_class); mutually exclusive with labeled cohorts.
test_blind_paths.title: Test Blind Paths

test_control_paths.description: Sample directory paths for control/class-0 test set.
test_control_paths.title: Test Control Paths

test_disease_paths.description: Sample directory paths for disease/class-1 test set.
test_disease_paths.title: Test Disease Paths

test_group_paths.description: For multi-class: list of {label: str, paths: list} or {class_index: int, paths: list}. Order must match classifier class_names. Resolved to absolute paths.
test_group_paths.title: Test Group Paths

train_control_paths.description: Training split: class-0 paths when using train/holdout dual evaluation (with holdout_*).
train_control_paths.title: Train Control Paths

train_disease_paths.description: Training split: class-1 paths for dual evaluation.
train_disease_paths.title: Train Disease Paths

train_group_paths.description: Multiclass training split paths (same shape as test_group_paths). Used with holdout_group_paths.
train_group_paths.title: Train Group Paths

title: PredictorConfig
